title: GitHub Copilot adapter (CLI, VS Code)
description: Managed block in ~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md (core rules inline, router just in time) and five custom agents in ~/.copilot/agents. Skills come from ~/.agents/skills.
postInstall: GitHub Copilot: start a new copilot session to load ~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md (COPILOT_HOME moves the whole folder). The core rules are inlined, not imported. Custom agents are ~/.copilot/agents/*.agent.md with tools read/search/execute/edit/web and no model line, so they inherit your model; add model: <name> per file to route roles. VS Code also reads ~/.claude/agents, so with Claude Code installed each role may appear twice there. No hooks are installed; see components/copilot/HOOKS.md.
